description: Episode vessels are born by mkepisode, never mkdir. A PreToolUse hook on Bash refuses a command that would create a new directory directly under $MIADI_CHRONICLE_ROOT and returns the mkepisode invocation — with the --adopt repair for a directory that already holds work. Creating directories inside an episode that already exists is not blocked, and a host with no MIADI_CHRONICLE_ROOT is not guarded at all. Hooks load at session start and do not hot-swap: restart Claude Code after changing this file. A Stop hook (address-check.mjs) sends the agent back when its reply names an episode or prints a circle id without its @miadi/reference-ui address (miadi-chronicle://563, miadi-circle://circle:…), to send the complete reply again with the addresses in it, and counts the characters of what comes back so the last message stays the reply a person annotates, jgwill/miadi-orchestration-kit#103. Two hooks (chart-pulse.sh) call miadi-chart-pulse from the miadi-chronicle-server package for a session that sets MIADI_CHART_PULSE_STORE: a commit with no chart move stops the turn, and the agent moves the chart and sends its complete reply again.
